title: perebea guianensis subsp. castilloides
intro: Perebea guianensis subsp. castilloides, commonly known as a plant species in the family Icacinaceae, is a tropical plant native to the Guianas and Brazil. The health benefits of Perebea guianensis subsp. castilloides include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antipyretic properties, which help to reduce inflammation, prevent infections, and lower body temperature. The bioactive constituents of Perebea guianensis subsp. castilloides include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
